The scientist Fennel was looking for you

The scientist Fennel was looking for you
a little while ago!{VAR BE01}

Wow!
It's a shiny Gym Badge!{VAR BE01}
Getting that Badge proved you have skill
enough to handle whatever comes next!

I too studied at the Trainers' School
when I was a beginner.

Some Trainers train themselves and
their Pokémon in the Dreamyard.{VAR BE01}
You might think about going there...
Could be you'll find something...

I'm so glad you came.
I'd like to give you this!{VAR BE01}

To live quietly and do a lot of fishing...
I truly live my ideal existence!

A Dusk Ball works well at night
or in a cave.{VAR BE01}
Plus, its name is excellent!
The Dusk Ball. Dusk!
